On September 11, 2001 the world watched the attacks on the World Trade Center unfold from the outside, and in the years since, nearly every angle has been revisited. “102 Minutes Inside the Towers” shifts that perspective inward, revealing what people inside the buildings saw and heard as events unfolded around them and they raced to survive. Over the course of 102 minutes, first responders and everyday workers--from window washers and bankers, to building security staff, lived their own harrowing narratives scattered throughout the buildings. Now they share never-before-heard accounts of fear, heroism, and humanity. Through new first-person interviews and carefully crafted visual effects that illuminate locations and movement within the towers, the special creates a vital historical record of lived experience on 9/11, told moment by moment from the inside out.

p.d: Mike Wolfe has spent decades tracking down elusive treasures, hidden gems and bargaining with awesome collectors of the past, but now, it’s Mike’s turn to share that history by revealing the stories of extraordinary finds by ordinary people.

Off the coast of Nova Scotia sits a small island that is a riddle wrapped in enigma. In the 1700s, people noticed strange lights there at night, and the person sent to investigate them disappeared. What lies beneath Oak Island? No one knows, and anyone who has tried to find out has encountered an unexpected problem -- booby-traps. Someone went to great measures to hide whatever is there, because as soon as you dig down a few feet, sea-water from various hidden, man-made channels floods the hole. Enter the Lagina brothers from Michigan. Older brother Rick is obsessed with decoding the secrets, so his little brother and Texas oilman, Marty, spent a fortune to buy access to the island. This summer, they'll use their deep pockets to dig and deploy technology like never before. This could be it, but there will be obstacles. The island is allegedly cursed. There's an old prophecy that says 7 will die before the treasure is found. The Laginas are fully aware of the death toll so far...6.

W czasie swojej pracy muszą podejmować szybkie i trudne decyzje oraz zmagać się z nieoczekiwanymi okolicznościami. W sytuacjach awaryjnych mogą polegać wyłącznie na swoich umiejętnościach oraz oddanych przyjaciołach.
